description: Chicago Graph and Travel Time Data is a data set deposited in Zenodo by its authors Marc Goerigk, Michael Hartisch. This dataset provides real-world traffic data collected from bus drivers in Chicago. Further information can be found in the documentation. Coverage: not stated; the metadata date the deposit to 2025. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support transport-network, traffic and mobility studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-zenodo-repository.
